messages:
Ava (CSM): Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Vela Systems. High-level goal: enable their first production inference flow within 30 days and validate cost targets. Quick agenda: stakeholders, success criteria, 6-week timeline, and known risks.
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can own the integration plan + sample prompts. Need to confirm which model family they want to start with (Llama-variant or opt-compatible).
Maya (Vela Systems - PM): Thanks — we prefer an MPT-like open model to start (privacy reqs), but we'll take Redwood recommendations. Primary success metrics: endpoint latency < 300ms p95, median cost per 1k tokens < target, and 3 workflows automated.
Sam (Onboarding PM): Proposed timeline: Week 0: SSO + access + kickoff; Week 1-2: API integration + smoke tests; Week 3: internal training + evals; Week 4-5: pilot with 10 power users; Week 6: go/no-go review. Thoughts?
Ava (CSM): Looks good. Success criteria to track: 1) API auth working, 2) 5 sample generation prompts passing quality threshold, 3) training session recorded and attended by 5 users, 4) cost projection within 10% of target. I'll add these to the shared checklist.

onboard-bot: New onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Vela-123 (access: team only)
Diego (Solutions Eng): Action items for me: share sample prompt set by tomorrow, run baseline perf on dedicated/dev, and provide a fallback model variant for SLOs. ETA: EOD tomorrow for prompts.
Maya (Vela Systems - PM): SSO is with Okta, we'll share metadata by EOD. One risk: legal wants encryption-at-rest proof for embeddings — Sam can you loop security?
Sam (Onboarding PM): Noted. I'll ping eng-security and request the encryption docs. Also scheduling training: propose Thurs 10am PT for power-user session — ok for everyone?
Ava (CSM): Thurs 10am PT works for me. I'll prepare onboarding slides and a short checklist for go/no-go.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Quick note: sample curl for integration I plan to share:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"vela-mpt-1", "prompt":"<sample>", "max_tokens":256}'
```
Use this to validate tokens and headers.
Maya (Vela Systems - PM): Perfect. We'll run the basic smoke and share results in this thread. One ask from my side: can we capture early user feedback in a simple form? Prefer a short 5-question survey after pilot sessions.
Ava (CSM): Yes — I'll set up a short post-session survey and link it in the pilot invite. We'll also add a prompt-level quality rubric for the evals.
Sam (Onboarding PM): I'll produce a one-page risk register for the 6-week window (SSO delay, legal encryption sign-off, data schema mismatch). Will share by EOD today.
Ava (CSM): Great. Recap of owners: Diego -> integration & sample prompts; Sam -> timeline, risk register, scheduling; Ava -> success criteria + slides + survey; Maya -> SSO + internal pilot users. Next sync: Thurs 10am PT (training). If any blocker arises before then, please @mention the thread. :thumbsup:
_meta: format: slack thread; messages are chronological; single continuous field 'messages' contains the root message and replies.
